title: Messy Data Extractor
summary: Data extraction from messy CSV, Excel and PDF files: tables are pulled out, cleaned and merged into one consistent sheet.
result: Supplier files with mixed dates, prices and column layouts become one consistent table in seconds, with a log of every fix.

metric.label: of retyping supplier files saved per week

note: Demo built with fictitious supplier files that reproduce common real-world problems. Time saved is an estimate.

screenshots.alt: Before and after: a messy supplier CSV turned into a clean, consistent sheet
Import run: files detected, fixes applied and price changes vs. the last import

upworkBlurb: Data extraction and cleanup pipeline: tables are extracted from messy CSV, Excel and PDF files (merged headers, mixed date formats, currency text, duplicates, split columns), normalized and merged into one clean Google Sheet with a summary tab and a log of every fix. Runs as a Python script on a schedule or from a menu in Google Sheets. Saves about 4 hours a week of retyping (estimate). Demo uses fictitious supplier files. Stack: Python (pandas, pdfplumber), Google Sheets, Apps Script.
